backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing access control, user profiles, approvals, and chat request storage with admin-gated operations and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, related files, components, and confidence metadata for approval, admin dashboard, and pending‑state features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of various frontend TS/TSX files including auth, layout, Firebase integration, deployment docs, and styling.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook outlining build steps, approval‑gating verification, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures for LIVE Firebase deployment.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining authentication, admin role checks, approval checks, and permissions for users, chat requests, chats, and messages.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors, borders, and layout.
frontend/index.html: Initializes Firebase via CDN and loads the main React entry point.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Smoke test checklist validating signup flows, approval gating, login behavior, and console log patterns across approved, unapproved, and missing‑profile users.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Implements client-side routing with React state and guards, rendering screens based on path and auth status.
frontend/src/components/admin/PendingUse: Displays a dialog showing detailed profile and contact info for a pending user.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides dropdown actions for approving, rejecting, blocking, promoting, or viewing a user with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Restricts access to admin-only routes by checking Firestore user roles.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Protects routes by requiring login and approval unless the user is an admin.
Wraps auth pages in a centered layout with a footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Allows access only to super-admin users, showing a loading state during profile fetch.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the main header with logo and user menu, reading profile details from Firestore.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Renders a dropdown profile menu showing user info and navigation options, including admin-only items and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Listens to Firebase Auth state from CDN-loaded modules and exposes the current authenticated user and loading status.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestorePendingUs: Fetches pending users from Firestore and provides mutations for approving, rejecting, blocking, or promoting them with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Retrieves the logged-in user's Firestore profile with fresh reads and disables caching.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Loads all users from Firestore and provides mutations to update approval status or roles with automatic refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wraps CDN-loaded Firebase, providing Firestore helpers like checking first user, creating profiles, and fetching data.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to human-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Maps user profile state to a post-login route based on approval and role.
Resizes and compresses profile images to JPEG under 200KB and returns processed data.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides a helper to merge Tailwind and clsx class names.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-only screen showing a placeholder for upcoming chat management inside the admin layout.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard summarizing user statistics from Firestore with loading skeletons and protected access.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Provides the admin UI layout with sidebar navigation, mobile sheet menu, and routed content area.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin-only screen presenting a placeholder for future reporting and analytics features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin-only screen showing a placeholder for upcoming application settings management.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Displays a pending-users admin table with actions like approve, reject, block, and promote, gated by admin roles.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Displays the user’s chat list and messages, handles polling, and sends new messages.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Shows a welcome message and basic dashboard cards for navigation.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles email/password login, profile checks, and redirects based on user status.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: Provides a UI for submitting a manual admin-handled password reset request.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Informs users their account awaits admin approval and offers return-to-login navigation.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Displays the logged-in user's Firestore profile with avatar, name, email, and role, handling loading and missing-profile states.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Implements user signup with form fields, image capture/processing, validation, and Firebase sign-up submission.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Shows approved users and manages chat requests, including sending, receiving, and responding to requests.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Provides a full users list with controls to approve or unapprove users using React Query.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads the user's profile and renders the unified approved users list, showing a loader or error when necessary.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading and persisting URL parameters and session-based values, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing planned super admin dashboard and user approval workflow requirements.
